subject: english
question:
Identify the error in the given sentence and select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

The day is longer than year on Venus.

options.text: A day is longer than the year on Venus
All day is longer than a year on Venus:
Day is longer than the year on Venus.
A day is longer than a year on Venus

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of articles.
 
• The original sentence lacks the article "a" before "day" and "a" before "year."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article ("a" or "an").
 
• The correct phrase should be "A day is longer than a year on Venus," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A day is longer than a year on Venus."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "A day is longer than the year on Venus"** – This option is incorrect because "the year" is not specific in this context.
 
• **B: "All day is longer than a year on Venus:"** – This option is incorrect because "All day" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• **C: "Day is longer than the year on Venus."** – This option is incorrect because "Day" should have the article "A" before it, and "the year" is not specific.
